rows.grounds: loc. sg. of anuyāga-kāla-lābha (compound); L1/L2: 'anuyāga' = subsequent rite, 'kāla-lābha' = obtaining the time
tasmāt (abl. adv., therefore) + prayateta (3sg. opt. mid. of pra-√yat, should strive); L1/L2: prescriptive injunction
tat-paramaḥ (nom. sg. m. bahuvrīhi/tatpuruṣa, having that as highest aim); L1/L2: describes the practitioner
bha-graha-samaya-viśeṣaḥ (nom. sg. m. compound); L1/L2: 'bha' = asterism, 'graha' = planet, 'samaya' = time, 'viśeṣa' = particular
na (neg.) + āśvayuje (loc. sg. of āśvayuja, the month/period Āśvayuja); L1/L2: temporal restriction
kaḥ (nom. sg. m. interrogative/indef.) + api (particle, even/at all) with sandhi; L1/L2: indefinite pronoun
instr. sg. m./n. of tad (therefore/by that reason); L1/L2: instrumental/causal
tad-varjam (acc. sg. n. used adverbially, except that); L1/L2: exclusion of the specified time
